name: Mass Driver Accelerator
description: A 3-5 kilometer electromagnetic linear accelerator that launches pressurized transit pods to suborbital velocity (Mach 6-12) using sequential magnetic pulses through superconducting coils. The pod rides a magnetic sled with zero physical contact — no friction, no fuel, only electromagnetism. Passengers experience 3.2g for 8 seconds during acceleration. The technology replaced conventional air travel for intercontinental point-to-point transit. 847 accelerators are deployed worldwide as of 2200, with the largest hub being the Meridian 88 Apex Complex (4 tubes, 40,000 passengers/day).
tier_availability: Tier 3-5 (passenger), universal (cargo). Passenger tickets cost Φ800-2,400 depending on distance. Cargo pods cost Φ12/metric ton.
social_impact: Created a two-tier transit system: hyperlanes for the masses (Φ15, 45 minutes), mass drivers for the wealthy (Φ800, 7 minutes). The same two points connected by both — the experience determined entirely by ability to pay. Cargo mass drivers democratized global freight, making intercontinental shipping cheaper than surface transport.
story_hooks: A mass driver pod goes off-trajectory mid-flight — is it a malfunction, sabotage, or something in the pod that shouldn't be there?
A Tier 1 character rides a mass driver for the first time on someone else's Quanta — the 14 minutes between worlds
